operator_notes.busy_gpus: Run with --allow-busy-gpus (author-approved). An idle ComfyUI process held about 425 MiB on each GPU (NVML reports ~944 MiB used per GPU with the driver reserve) at 0% utilization; it was not stopped.
operator_notes.other_process_sampling: nvidia-smi pmon every ~20 s during the run window; '-' (no activity) counted as 0
notes: Knee between 16 and 17 req/s: TTFT p50 252 ms at 16, 2.6 s at 17, 45 s at 24. The overload stop never fired twice in a row, so all 16 steps ran (the ladder was not trimmed).
3 requests of about 36,000 failed with aiohttp ServerDisconnectedError on the client (rate04, rate14, rate16); no server-side errors.
Power cap held for 93-96% of samples at every step.
